_comment: Single source of truth for job-board enums. Imported by src/lib/jobsTaxonomy.ts and read directly by scripts/publish-jobs.mjs, so the TypeScript UI and the Node validator can never disagree. Any change here must be matched by a migration in lms/supabase/migrations/.
